Counting the berries: there are 6 red raspberries (one at the top, one at center-top, one left, one lower-left, one center-right, and one far right, which makes 6 or 7) and 5 blackberries or similar dark berries.

Raspberries weigh about 4-5 g each, so 7 of them come to about 30 g. Blackberries weigh about 5-6 g each, so 6 of them come to about 33 g.

The plate is a square plate about 25 cm across, and the berries are small relative to it, which fits these weights.
